label: Strands Agents
description: The workflow becomes a Strands Agents flow: an async function for each block, Strands Agents (OpenAIModel, tools, structured_output_model for typed answers) for the AI blocks, and a FLOW that AgentCanvas's flow engine runs as the canvas draws it. Any catalog model works, and tool calls can wait for a person's approval (a hook that uses Strands' own interrupts). Runs need Strands installed on the server (`make framework FW=strands`); designing and exporting do not. No saved history, state editing or breakpoints; a paused run lives in memory.

notes.core.set: an async function that returns the fields it sets
notes.core.router: the flow engine follows the first route whose CEL rule matches (generated orchestration: the flow does not use Strands' GraphBuilder yet)
notes.core.join: the flow engine waits for every branch before the block runs
notes.core.approval: the run pauses and is saved as JSON; it continues from that step when a person answers
notes.core.human_input: the run pauses and asks again when an answer does not fit
notes.core.script: your workspace function is called from the flow
notes.knowledge.search: the flow searches the knowledge base; exports search its file with the built-in embedder
notes.core.llm: a Strands Agent with the block's model, asked once with agent.invoke_async
notes.core.agent: a Strands Agent (system prompt, OpenAIModel, tools, structured_output_model); tools named in 'Ask before using' are interrupted by an AskBefore hook (BeforeToolCallEvent.interrupt): the agent's messages and interrupt state are saved with the pause, and it continues with an interruptResponse once a person approves, edits or rejects each call
notes.mw.model_call_limit: Strands' own Limits(turns=...): past the limit the agent stops with a note, or the run fails when the block says so
